decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the north and south wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - It is considered that this application for a roof extension to dwellinghouse because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of number 356 Jersey Road and is complementary to the visual amenity of the locality and would not be detrimental to the amenities of adjoining and neighbouring properties and would preserve the character of the Conservation Area.  The development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B 1.1 (New Development) ENV B 2.2 (Conservation Areas) H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
description: Erection of a  rear roof extension and 2 rooflights to front elevation of existing dwellinghouse
